acceptance: Every rule in the plan's DDL table has a transpile_ddl test; rules with an obtainable engine (chdb or container for ClickHouse, Trino, StarRocks, Doris, Postgres, PySpark) execute the DDL and compare the created schema.
Engines not obtainable (Athena, Fabric, Synapse, Redshift, managed Databricks) are recorded as documented gaps in the PR, for sign-off.
No benchmark table names in the fork; fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PRs merged.
description: Extend transpile_ddl to the config-driven and tuning-driven rules: ClickHouse Nullable strip, MergeTree, ORDER BY; Doris and StarRocks key models and type maps; Presto/Trino/Spark/Velox/Lakesail Hive and Delta/Iceberg/ORC/Parquet clauses; Athena external tables; Fabric/Synapse schema prefix and distribution; Redshift DISTSTYLE/SORTKEY; Databricks catalog-managed TBLPROPERTIES; pg_mooncake heap-then-mirror. Adapter config and tuning values arrive as DdlOptions fields. Expect two PRs.
